bill.title: Afghanistan Vetting and Accountability Act of 2026

aiDescription.summary: The bill requires DHS to verify personal and biometric data and conduct in-person vetting of Afghan evacuees, maintain a vetting database, report quarterly, and permit GAO audits. It applies to noncitizen, non-military evacuees from Afghanistan during the 2021 U.S. evacuation operations and bars unvetted individuals from Federal means-tested benefits, unemployment.

impact.summary: The bill directs DHS to verify personal and biometric data, conduct in‑person vetting, and create a database for non‑citizens evacuated from Afghanistan, including Operation Allies Welcome evacuees, and report to Congress. Evacuees who refuse vetting are barred from unemployment compensation and Federal means‑tested public benefits.
